failure_condition: Route replacement removes the focused element and leaves focus at the document body rather than the new content.
expected_outcome: The control moves focus to the new main content; the defective version loses the content focus context.
manual_verification_method: Keyboard-test the sequence and judge whether focus order preserves meaning and operability for the actual flow.
accessibility_tree_testability: Can observe the focused AX node if Chromium exposes it.
limitations: Focus loss alone is not automatically a 2.4.3 failure; the criterion mapping is interpretive.
